task: Locate a recipe for sushi rolls on Allrecipes with a minimum of 20 reviews. Show the Nutrition Facts and the main ingredients. Tell me how to store these rolls.
answer:
FINAL: Allrecipes’ Homemade Sushi meets the requirement with 147 reviews (4.5/5 from 217 ratings).

[Homemade Sushi recipe](https://www.allrecipes.com/recipe/24228/sushi-roll/), updated September 7, 2026; checked October 27, 2026. It makes 8 servings, yielding 4 cut rolls.

Main ingredients for the original batch:

- ⅔ cup uncooked short-grain white rice
- 4 nori sheets
- ½ pound imitation crabmeat
- 1 avocado
- ½ cucumber
- 2 tablespoons pickled ginger
- Seasoning: 3 tablespoons rice vinegar, 3 tablespoons sugar and 1½ teaspoons salt

Nutrition Facts per serving, from the recipe’s expanded label:

| Nutrient | Amount |
|---|---:|
| Calories | 152 |
| Total fat | 4 g |
| Saturated fat | 1 g |
| Cholesterol | 6 mg |
| Sodium | 703 mg |
| Total carbohydrate | 26 g |
| Dietary fiber | 2 g |
| Total sugars | 7 g |
| Protein | 4 g |
| Vitamin C | 3 mg |
| Calcium | 12 mg |
| Iron | 1 mg |
| Potassium | 186 mg |

Storage: These crab, avocado and cucumber rolls are best eaten the day they are made. To keep leftovers overnight, wrap tightly in plastic wrap, put in an airtight container and refrigerate promptly. Do not leave them at room temperature longer than 1–2 hours. Refrigeration makes the rice firmer and the nori softer. This guidance comes from [Oh My Food Recipes’ California roll storage advice](https://www.ohmyfoodrecipes.com/homemade-california-roll/).
